notes.title: A small update to celebrate Debut Fest! - v0.3.1.2
notes.notes:
Patch notes for the update I mentioned in my big announcement thing. Been a while since the last update. Anyways, enjoy:

Fixes:
Fixed item type icons in the techshop being clickable and wreaking havoc

Fixed Temporary Shield ability blocking player laser attacks

Fixed Tesla Defence System being active by default and not consuming ability charge

Fixed Side Zapper II attack visual being visible at the beginning of battles as a single line

Fixed profile deletion not working

Fixed continuous laser weapons ignoring range restrictions

Fixed made aim indicator more precise

Fixed dash button being stretched incorrectly on non 16:9 aspect ratios


Improvements:
Made the game's intro cutscene be turned off by default

Tweaked tutorial dialogue a bit

Moved item selling from the Workshop to the Tech Shop

Moved repair button from the ship panel to the shop panel

Replaced No Misinputs perk with Improved Target Recognition: Deal and recieve no friendly fire damage.

Improved starmap generation, so that it is less likely to encounter many stations in a row

Adjusted combat camera movement to pan more towards pointer

Made primary weapon rotation indepent of ship rotation making it easier and less confusing to aim

Added more settings options: bloom intensity, screenshake, saturation

Added a notch on the ability indicator, no show the energy consumption of the ability

Implemented a run timer, and added it to the run preview panel

Updated pause menu exit warning text to make it clear progress is saved

Added version number in the corner of the main menu and pause menu (why wasn't this already in?)

notes.title: Hotfix - v0.3.1.1
notes.notes:
A quick hotfix addressing a bunch of stuff I wanted but couldn't fit into the last update. 

Important note: Rate of development will slow down significantly in the next two months, as I have other responsibilities I have to attend to. That said, if you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, be sure to share them with me, I'll try to address them as quickly as I can.

Fixes

 Fixed aim indicator line not being there in the tutorial
 Fixed tutorial objective indicator lingering after the objective is already complete
 Fixed pausing while getting back to the starmap
 Fixed being able to fight the final boss multiple times to farm profile XP
 Fixed unlocking a perk at upon beating the game causing loading error
 Fixed miswritten forge and workshop tooltips


Improvements

 Added more info about the forge and workshop to the map legend
 Made tier 0 weapons sell for half the price of tier I weapons instead of nothing at all
 Tweaked sell and dismantle areas' background a bit

notes.title: Small update adding partial gamepad support and fixes - v0.3.1.0
notes.notes:
So, ladies and gentlemen, after squeezing out as much work as I could in the last few days I can proudly announce that the game has gamepad support now! Well sort of... 

This is far from a complete and proper implementation, but it is a start. The game can be played fully with a gamepad, but input rebinding and glyphs indicating inputs are missing. The menu and map navigation can also be a bit tricky. But it works, so go try it out! And if you encounter any issues or have suggestions, be sure to submit them via Discord or the feedback button in the main menu.

Also, this update has a bunch of fixes and balance improvements, but I couldn't fix every bug and issue that came up the last few days. I'll be working on them in the coming days.

Features

 Ad-hoc gamepad support


Fixes:

 Fixed miswritten description for the Power Of Greed perk
 Fixed a few perk descriptions
 Fixed a few status bar tooltips
 Fixed side weapons targeting the final boss's shield
 Fixed some perks bugging out when one or all side weapons are missing
 Fixed lost wreckage event cutscene not ending sometimes
 Fixed typo on map legend panel
 Fixed worse player stats when starting from tutorial


Improvements

 Added a few tooltips to the shop panel
 Added a couple new settings


Balance

 Made a few events easier
 Nerfed Covert Craft mercenary
 Increased Federal electric weapon charge time
 Rebalanced Titanate and Enlightened Boss health and attacks
 Made Velan boss spawn a bit more mines
 Nerfed enemy mine damage (not by a lot mind you)
 Made Act III easier
 Swapped and tweaked Forge and Workshop sell and dismantle areas
 Increased player starting turning speed
 Increased dash upgrade's effectiveness on dash cooldown

notes.title: Fixing what the last patch broke. - v0.3.0.9
notes.notes:
Here's another patch fixing stuff I broke with yesterday's patch. Thanks for everyone reporting the bug!

Fixes:

Fixing the bug where perks couldn't be selected


Balance:

notes.title: First hotfix coming in hot! - v0.3.0.8
notes.notes:
First hotfix coming out already fixing a few issues and improving the balance of the game. There are already a few known issues, I'll try to address them when I'll have a bit of time. Meanwhile, enjoy this teeny little patch.

Changes include:
Fixes:

Fixed SFX setting not applying to certain sound effects

Improvements:

Improved shop panel navigation a bit

Balance:

Increased each objective type's money yield by 5
Increased some anomalies' money and component yield
Increased the tier of some anomalies' equipment drops
Made an anomaly mini-boss easier

notes.title: New demo update!
notes.notes: I updated the demo once again, fixing and improving upon many things, mostly based on player feedback I received at the recent next fest! Also added some more content in lacking areas, and rebalanced some things.

notes.title: Rustwing Demo Major Update!
notes.notes:
Demo update is out!
Rustwing's demo just got a major update! It introduces new content, fixes and many general improvements! Most notably, it finally receives a much needed tutorial, an intro cutscene and exposition to the story, as well as an increased variety in combat scenarios. There are many more improvements, go check it out yourself. If you like what you play, consider wishlisting it! Also if you have anything you want to share with me, you can do it via the feedback from (accessible in the main menu).
